highlights: UGREEN Wireless Mouse 2.4G & Bluetooth Mouse Rechargeable Silent Mouse Multi-Device 4000 DPI with USB Unifying Receiver Compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, Linux, Chrome OS

Multi-Device Wireless Bluetooth Mouse: UGREEN wireless mouse provides bluetooth 5.0/3.0 and 2.4G USB connection, working distance up to 10m. Easily switch between up to 3 computers or laptops with a button on the bottom of the mouse, saving a lot of time and making the work more productive.

4000 DPI High Sensitivity & 5 Powerful Buttons: With 4 adjustable DPI levels (4000/2000/1600/1000), UGREEN wireless mouse could provide higher sensitivity for faster and accurate tracking. 4000 DPI can greatly enhance work efficiency by up to 130%. Featuring a 5-button design, you’ll quickly switch from page to page on the web in an instant and save time with the Forward/Backward buttons of this computer mouse.

Rechargeable Silent Mouse: Noiseless click, no worrying about disturbing others beside you, let you concentrate on work. Built-in durable Li-ion rechargeable battery, it can be easily charged using the USB C cable (cable is NOT included). 2 hours charging, you can use this wireless mouse for 3 months.

Modern, Slim, Beautiful Pebble Shape: The rechargeable wireless mouse stands out for its simplicity and beautiful design, feels good in the hand without wrist fatigue even after long time use in the office, and is easy to carry around.

Wide Compatibility: Plug and play wireless, bluetooth mode works with Windows / Android / MAC OS system. 2.4GHz mode works with laptop, desktop or any device with USB port, simply plug the USB receiver, plug and play.
